units.source_text: 可是，這些正是「科學的謊言」「統計的謊言」「數學的謊言」。

en.t: But these are precisely the lies of science, the lies of statistics, and the lies of mathematics.

units.source_text: 三粒米飯根本無法想象能彙集在一起，就算作為加減乘除的應用問題，這也是過於原始和低階的題目。

en.t: It is impossible even to imagine three grains of cooked rice gathering together, and even as an applied problem in arithmetic, it is far too primitive and low-level a subject.

units.source_text: 就像在黑燈瞎火的廁所裡，一隻腳踩空掉進便池的概率，

en.t: It is like calculating the probability that, in a pitch-dark toilet, one foot will miss its step and fall into the pit,

units.source_text: 以及省線電車的乘客中有多少人不小心掉入電車車門與月臺的縫隙中，

en.t: or how many passengers on a government-line train will accidentally slip into the gap between the train door and the platform,

units.source_text: 要計算出這樣的概率，實在是愚蠢之舉。

en.t: to calculate probabilities like that is truly foolish.

units.source_text: 儘管這樣的事情可能會發生，但因踩空掉進廁所腳受傷的例子從未聽說過。

en.t: Although such things might happen, I have never heard of anyone hurting a foot by missing a step and falling into a toilet.

units.source_text: 我被這種假設的「科學事實」洗腦，直至昨天我還把它視為現實加以接受，並擔驚受怕。

en.t: I had been indoctrinated by such hypothetical scientific facts, and until yesterday I accepted them as reality and lived in fear.
